statement: BioEmu integrates more than 200 ms of molecular-dynamics data with static structures and experimental stability information, generates thousands of approximately independent protein conformations per hour on one GPU, captures motions including cryptic-pocket formation, and reports useful relative free-energy agreement on evaluated systems.
locator: Science 2025 publication summary and Microsoft Research publication page
notes: Counterevidence against claiming ensemble ML is wholly immature; scope and transferability still require careful benchmarking.
